mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(distance),0) AS estMileage, COALESCE(SUM(use_time),0) AS estDuration FROM bbx_work_task WHERE business_type = #{businessType} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted =1

SELECT t.business_id AS type, COUNT(CASE WHEN i.error_status = 0 THEN 1 END) AS normalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN i.error_status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS abnormalCount FROM bbx_work_order o INNER JOIN bbx_work_task t ON o.id = t.work_id AND t.business_type = 3 AND t.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND t.deleted = 1 INNER JOIN bbx_work_task_item i ON o.id = i.work_id AND i.business_type = 2 AND i.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND i.deleted = 1 -- 假设明细表直接关联工单ID WHERE o.status = 50 AND o.source = 'patrolPlan' AND o.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND o.deleted = 1 GROUP BY t.business_id

SELECT t.business_id AS id, t.name,t.space_full_path AS spaceName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM bbx_work_order o INNER JOIN bbx_work_task t ON o.id = t.work_id AND t.business_type = 2 AND t.error_status = 1 AND t.tenant_id =#{tenantId} AND t.deleted = 1 WHERE o.source = 'inspectionPlan' AND o.status = 50 AND o.tenant_id =#{tenantId} AND o.deleted = 1 GROUP BY t.business_id ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10
